title: The Secret Playlist
author: Astrid Kavanagh
blurb: Hazel Marchetti, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
